neighbours.label: the subword token 'yc' inside a word (ac-yc-lovir, C-yc-lopamine), plus similar mid-word pieces such as 'orp' and 'eph'
fire: The doctor prescribed acyclovir for the cold sores on her lip.
For shingles, many clinics still start patients on acyclovir tablets.
Researchers found that cyclopamine blocked tumor growth in mice.
The cream contains acyclovir and should be applied five times a day.
In chemistry class we learned that an acyclic compound has no ring.
Valacyclovir is converted in the body into acyclovir after absorption.
The plant compound cyclopamine causes birth defects in sheep.
Her pharmacist warned that acyclovir can upset the stomach.
quiet: The doctor prescribed ibuprofen for the swelling on her lip.
For shingles, many clinics still start patients on antiviral tablets.
Researchers found that the new compound blocked tumor growth in mice.
The cream contains zinc oxide and should be applied five times a day.
In chemistry class we learned that an aromatic compound has a ring.
Paracetamol is converted in the liver into several metabolites after absorption.
The plant compound solanine causes poisoning in sheep.
Her pharmacist warned that aspirin can upset the stomach.
